info.name: HelpFlow - support-ticket-service and technician-dispatch-service
info.description:
End-to-end test collection. Run the folders in order (Collection Runner) against a running stack.

Required environment values: adminEmail/adminPassword and technicianPassword (BOOTSTRAP_* in your .env). Everything else is generated.

request.description: Deterministic: the same ticketId + categoria + prioridad always returns the same technician and estimate.

exec: pm.test('Availability matches the estimate', function () { const h = b.tiempoEstimadoHoras; const e = h <= 2 ? 'ALTA' : (h <= 8 ? 'MEDIA' : 'BAJA'); pm.expect(b.disponibilidad).to.eql(e); });

item.name: Same request again returns the same answer

request.description: Creates an ACTIVO ROLE_USUARIO account. The e-mail is generated on every run.

exec: pm.test('ACTIVO ROLE_USUARIO, no password', function () { pm.expect(u.status).to.eql('ACTIVO'); pm.expect(u.role).to.eql('ROLE_USUARIO'); pm.expect(u).to.not.have.property('password'); });
pm.test('email field reported', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors.map(e => e.field)).to.include('email'); });

request.description: Needs adminEmail/adminPassword in the environment (BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_* of your .env).

request.description: Registers in ABIERTO, computes the SLA deadline, asks technician-dispatch-service and applies the assignment rules, all in one transaction.

exec: pm.test('Assigned or waiting for a technician', function () { pm.expect(['ASIGNADO','ABIERTO']).to.include(t.status); });
pm.test('SLA deadline is 8 h for ALTA', function () { pm.expect((new Date(t.slaDueAt) - new Date(t.createdAt)) / 3600000).to.eql(8); });
